items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: I'm telling you that John was...

ctx.x: I never feel too much. I'm telling you that John was... It's a possibility. Yeah, I'm sure. It's not a little... Sometimes you don't feel as strong as the other, you know? I know. It's all the same feels. There's a man that... You know, the other man... He's always older. I get out of it. The more I pay attention... Before I pay attention. I pay attention to... I don't have to say this question. And I feel... I feel like I'm going to go to the Lord's daughter. Who seems to be... I don't know if he's two or three…
I don't know how they're doing. Have you paid with her at all?
